text:
ana: Heads up — incident with EU embeddings. Need marketing take on status page copy + timing. We should coordinate before customer email.

mike: Thanks. Root cause still investigating, ETA for fix ~45m. Suggest immediate 'Investigating' on statuspage and hold any launch social posts.

tara: Support queue starting to spike, routing inbound leads -> support triage. If SLA customers DM me for updates.

ben: Agreed. Also recommend webinar planned for Wed be postponed; let's draft comms for customers who signed up.

lisa: I'll draft a short statuspage blurb now. Want neutral tone, mention we're investigating and will update at 30m intervals. No speculation.

ana: +1. Also prep short 1-paragraph email for affected customers and a pinned note for sales reps.

mike: statuspage-bot: created incident 1973-EU-embeddings - state: investigating

status-bot: @channel Statuspage update posted: "Investigating — We are aware of errors affecting embeddings in eu-west-1. Our engineers are investigating. We will post updates every 30 minutes."

lisa: Draft v1:
```
Investigating — We are aware of an issue that is affecting embeddings in EU-West. Our engineers are investigating now. Some requests may return errors or increased latency. We’ll post updates here at 30-minute intervals and notify affected customers via email.
```

ana: Shorter social-safe blurb for paused launch: "We're investigating an issue affecting embeddings in EU regions. We're on it and will share updates."

tara: For support routing: inbound leads flagged "embeddings-error" -> queue #support-high -> tara, josh. Sales alerted CC:sales@redwood.com

ben: For the webinar: let's move to 'on hold' and email registrants with option to join a rescheduled date or receive recording. Draft: "Due to a service incident, we are rescheduling..."

lisa: Translations: I'll queue French and German. Hope to have within 30m of final copy.

ana: Can we get a timeline for next public update? Mike?

mike: Next update scheduled 30m from now at 1973256121. Will post status and any rollback plan if needed.

lisa: Sending email snippet for ops review:
```
We’re currently investigating an issue affecting our embeddings service in EU regions. A limited set of requests may return errors or slower responses. Our team is actively working on a fix. We will update you within 30 minutes.
```

tara: Support playbook note: add canned replies + link to statuspage. I'll attach to ticket template.

ana: ok thanks — once we have final copy, i'll push to customers and pause scheduled launch posts. @mike please ping when root cause found so we can draft postmortem teaser/benchmark narrative changes.

mike: Will do. updating thread with logs if useful:
```
ERROR 503 embedding pipeline: kv-cache OOM on p3.2xlarge
```

status-bot: Incident state changed to investigating -> identified

ben: Nice. Once identified, include mitigation steps and ETA in next update. Also capture impact metrics for comms: % requests failed, affected customers list.

ana: Good call. I'll prep two subject lines for the customer email and one for sales outreach.

lisa: Uploading translations to drive /marketing/incidents/1973254321

mike: last update for now at 1973254799 — hands on it, will update at next tick.

ana: thanks all :thumbsup:
